purpose: Classify the BraTS2020 ValidationData X-HD Figure-5 family after the geo/graphics/OSM exact-provenance searches.

facts_used: BraTS 2020 data access points users to the Registration/Data Request page.
Validation data was released through CBICA IPP, without ground-truth labels for participants.
All BraTS multimodal scans are distributed as NIfTI files and include T1, T1Gd/T1ce, T2, and T2-FLAIR volumes.
Provided data are preprocessed, co-registered, interpolated to 1 mm^3, and skull-stripped.
Training and validation data require a CBICA Image Processing Portal account and BraTS'20 Data Request.
After request approval, download links are provided through a Results.zip / REGISTRATION_STATUS workflow.
Training data include labels; validation data include the four modalities but not annotations.

evidence: Goal5301 records BraTS local_workspace_assets=absent and current_pod_assets=absent.
Goal5214 records /local/storage/shared/HDDatasets missing on the current POD.
Goal5214 sample BraTS log paths are known but not resolvable in the current POD.

known_uncertainties: The author logs expose NIfTI path names and point counts, but not the conversion rule from voxel data to point sets.
The official BraTS source provides MRI volumes, not X-HD-ready point clouds.
Exact reproduction needs the author conversion code, parameters, or hashes of the converted point representation.
Validation data include modalities but no annotations, so any point-selection rule must be inferred from author code/provenance rather than labels.

blocking_gaps: No authorized BraTS2020 validation NIfTI files are present locally or on the current POD.
No author BraTS input file hashes are present.
No author converted point-set hashes are present.
No deterministic author NIfTI-to-point conversion pipeline has been identified.
No proof exists that a newly downloaded BraTS2020 package would have the same bytes/order/conversion outputs as the author's /local/storage/shared/HDDatasets copy.
No denominator-aligned author/RTDL BraTS timing matrix exists.

level_b_possible_after: file hashes for the downloaded NIfTI inputs
an app-owned conversion script from NIfTI volume to X-HD point arrays
a same-input author hd_exec run on one paper-log pair
a same-input RTDL route run on the same converted point arrays
level_c_exact_requires_one_of: author-provided BraTS input files or hashes
author-provided converted point-set files or hashes
byte-identical regeneration from pinned BraTS source files plus documented author conversion
external review accepting a deterministic public/authorized regeneration as exact-equivalent

pod_usage.reason: The current blocker is data access and conversion provenance, not GPU execution. Use POD only after authorized data and a concrete conversion/verification input exist.

recommended_next_actions.action: Obtain authorized BraTS2020 validation data through CBICA IPP / BraTS'20 Data Request, if project policy permits.
Search author source/history for the NIfTI-to-point conversion rule used before hd_exec.
After data and conversion are available, reproduce one listed author-log pair as a Level-B same-source gate before attempting the full 500-pair BraTS matrix.

allowed_summary: BraTS2020 has strong author-log workload evidence (500 unique pairs / 2500 records), but exact reproduction is blocked on authorized NIfTI access and the author NIfTI-to-point conversion provenance. No BraTS route or performance claim is authorized yet.
not_allowed: claiming BraTS2020 exact paper input recovery
running route/performance work before authorized data and conversion provenance exist
using author log path names or point counts as exact input proof
